title: Add the entire-agent-devin external agent plugin

messages.message: Install Entire on this repo and make Devin a registered Entire agent.

Entire discovers external agents as `entire-agent-<name>` executables on $PATH, speaking JSON over stdin/stdout at protocol version 1. Devin runs in the cloud so it has no local hook process; I am adding the plugin plus a bridge that turns Devin API session activity into Entire hook events.

Plugin implements info/detect/get-session-id/get-session-dir/resolve-session-file/read-session/write-session/read-transcript/chunk-transcript/reassemble-transcript/format-resume-command/parse-hook, and stores raw transcripts outside the working tree so cloud session data never lands in the repo.

structured_output.summary: Registered Devin as an Entire external agent and bridged cloud sessions into Entire checkpoints.
